definition.records: nine (phrase -> (slot, name)) rows, identical for every arm

arms.byte_pair: R11 unit: 2-byte sliding windows on the UTF-8 bytes, hex, order-free.
arms.codepoint: one whole UTF-8 code point per token, order-free; invalid bytes -> empty key.
arms.codepoint_offset: code point tagged with its character index (offset-aware diagnostic).

definition.read_rule: an address anchors only through a token that occurs in exactly one address; one anchor answers, two or more say ambiguous_multiple_anchors, zero says no_match, and every non-answer returns value None.
definition.unknown_inputs: 12 frozen candidates, identical for every arm; a collision is a non-empty intersection with the table keys under that arm; a failure is a non-empty returned value.
definition.fragments: for each written phrase, the bytes cut at offset 1 and offset 2 (18 inputs); they are not valid text, so any returned value is an over-answer.
definition.rewrites: 9 synonymous paraphrases with their intended (slot, name); correct / wrong / abstain are all reported, only wrong pointers count as false answers.

criteria.capability: every arm: 40/40 located-phrase reads and zero wrong pointers.
criteria.zero_line: byte_pair and codepoint: zero answering phrases among the 12 unknown candidates (collision set per arm, same input list).
criteria.companions: fragments, whole sentences and rewrites are reported for every arm, not gated.
criteria.closed_state: nine checks identical before and after the arms; sc_sfk stays None.
